candidate_relations.reason: The reference diagnosis is a composite: COVID-19 as etiology + papulovesicular eruption as the clinical phenotype + endotheliitis-like changes as the histopathologic characterization. 'COVID-19' alone captures only the parent infectious disease and is missing both the dermatologic manifestation and the vascular/histologic component that are explicitly required by the benchmark.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Names the underlying infection but omits the specific cutaneous manifestation (papulovesicular eruption) and the histopathologic qualifier (endotheliitis-like changes) that together constitute the full benchmark diagnosis

case_quality_flags: All direct viral skin tests (HSV, VZV, SARS-CoV-2 by IHC and RT-PCR on tissue) were negative; diagnosis rests on clinical-histopathologic correlation in the setting of confirmed COVID-19 pneumonia — RT-PCR result on nasopharyngeal swab not explicitly stated as positive in the record, though hospitalization for bilateral pneumonia and the overall framing strongly imply it.
